s1.desc: a clinic waiting room drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a snowy field with a snow-capped pine tree on a hill behind

s3.desc: a snowy field beside a grassy patch of red and yellow flowers under a bright sky

spans.view: with a row of plastic chairs and an anatomy poster on the wall behind them

beats.text: Polly sits on a chair hugging her belly with an ice pack on her head and a worried look, while Pax sits beside her
Polly lowers her flippers and reaches one toward Pax, smiling with her eyes closed, while Pax sits still looking ahead
Pax closes his eyes with a small smile while Polly opens her eyes and looks ahead
Pax leans toward Polly and slips a flipper behind her back while she sits looking ahead

spans.notes: slow push-in with a slight drift through the whole shot from f0 (compare 0/12 and 0/57: chair, poster and door-frame edges doubled; ECC ~0.1% scale per frame on the poster band). The wall poster is a generic anatomy chart with a teal penguin silhouette, not a lead: treated as a prop. No overlay
fast punch-in f57-61 (ECC scale per frame 1.008, 1.029, 1.06, ...; total ~1.32x), then a slow sideways settle f62-69 (wall band still changing until f70). 13 frames
13 static frames after the punch-in (wall band identical f70-82): Pax sits with a flipper on Polly's back while she looks ahead, an almost held pose

spans.view: with a red car beside them, its trunk open

beats.text: Pax reaches into the open trunk of a red car with his back turned while Polly, beside him, raises her flippers to her chest
Pax turns around from the trunk hugging a tall armful of grocery bags while Polly stands behind him

spans.notes: camera locked f83-105 (ECC on the sky/tree band scale 1.000, 0 px, cc 1.000 to f105; compare 83/105 tree and car edges overlap). Background drawn soft-focus. The bags hold vegetables, a pail and a purple bag: no lead print. No overlay in the top third or bottom fifth | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v18): beat 1: Polly's flippers are at her sides f83-89 and only come up to her chest from f90
quick pull-back f106-111 (ECC scale 0.99, 0.97, 0.92 ... vs f105; still -0.7% at f111, pure pan from f112) while Pax turns with the grocery bags. 6 frames

pan left following Pax and Polly as they walk left toward an igloo, ~14 px per frame (ECC scale 1.000 on the tree band); Pax carries the grocery bags with a sweat drop, Polly follows. 19 frames, under 21 (split moves, curator ruling)
punch-in during the pan f131-134 (scale +2.8% then +6% frame to frame; from f135 pure pan again). 4 frames
pan left resumes f135-146 (~16 px per frame, slowing to ~10), the igloo door coming into view at the left. 12 frames

spans.view: with a bed of red and yellow flowers beside her

beats.text: Polly reaches a flipper into the flower bed and picks a red flower
Polly holds the red flower up in front of her and gazes at it as a wind swirl drifts past
Polly closes her eyes and sniffs the flower with a contented smile

spans.notes: camera locked f147-176 (bottom snow band pixel-identical; compare 147/176 flower and ground edges overlap). The flowers sway a little (in-world animation) and a white wind-swirl line drifts across the sky f154-176. The pull-back starts at f177
fast pull-back f177-181 from Polly alone to a wide two-shot; Pax in his scarf comes into the picture at the left during it. 5 frames

spans.view: with a bed of red and yellow flowers at the right

beats.text: Pax stands in a striped scarf looking over at Polly while she sniffs her red flower with her eyes closed
Pax closes his eyes with a smile and pulls the scarf off his neck
Pax walks over to Polly holding the scarf out in both flippers
Pax turns his back and wraps the scarf around Polly's neck, hiding her behind him

spans.notes: camera locked from f182 (bottom snow-streak band pixel-identical f182-211; still moving f181). Polly is mostly behind Pax f209-211; Pax stays fully visible. Scarf left off Pax's outfit list: he wears it only f182-193 (under 21 frames each side of taking it off), the beats say when it comes off

spans.view: with a bed of red and yellow flowers at the right

beats.text: Pax, with his back turned, tucks the striped scarf around Polly's neck and steps back to her side
Pax stands beside Polly and looks at her while Polly, wrapped in the scarf and holding her flower, looks ahead
Pax closes his eyes with a happy smile while Polly stands still beside him
Pax opens his eyes and looks at Polly while she stands holding her flower
Polly closes her eyes and blushes with a shy smile while Pax keeps looking at her

spans.notes: camera locked (right cloud band identical f212-260; compare 212/260 cloud, flower and hill edges overlap). At f212-215 Polly is mostly behind Pax

spans.view: with the top of a giant red heart under her

beats.text: Polly sits on top of a giant red heart with rosy cheeks, looking around and blinking
Polly folds her flippers over her belly and glances sideways bashfully, her beak slightly open

spans.notes: camera locked: the heart's edge at both frame corners is pixel-identical f261-293 (compare 261/293 heart edge overlaps). keep12 was low only because Polly fills the frame and moves
8 frames: Pax up close below the heart, pushing it up with a raised flipper
fast pull-back f302-305 to the final wide shot (whole-frame diff to previous 35, 23, 9, then 2.6 at f306 and 0 from f307). 4 frames

beats.text: Pax props up a giant red heart with one raised flipper, gazing up at Polly, who sits on top smiling shyly

spans.notes: camera locked from f306: the heart's left-lobe edge and Pax's floor shadow are pixel-identical f306-331 (still moving at f305); only Pax blinks. Skit ends on this shot
